heading: INT. VELVET TIPS NAIL LOUNGE - BACK ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. VELVET TIPS NAIL LOUNGE - BACK ROOM - NIGHT
Hi. Okay. Is it recording? It says recording. Great. This is my statement for the Q3 culture review, and I want to begin by saying I love this company.
units.name: DONNA
paren: sitting straight, clearing her throat, adjusting a headset that does not need adjusting

units.text: I love the open floor plan, which is a nail salon. I love that our break room is also the supply closet, and that our wellness program is the free acetone.
units.name: DONNA

units.text: Which is a joke. That is a joke. Please mark it as humor.
units.name: DONNA

units.text: There are two people in this story. Marcy in Accounts and Marty in Facilities. Marcy sends the emails. Marty receives the emails. Except it's reversed, because the system autocorrects them, and for eleven months I have been invoicing Marty's boiler repairs to Marcy's bonus.
units.name: DONNA
paren: picks up a bottle of polish, reads the label, puts it down

units.text: And Marcy knows. And Marty knows. And I know that they know. And nobody says anything, because this is a culture of respect.
units.name: DONNA

units.text: This is the last time they will speak to me as a colleague.
units.name: DONNA

units.text: So here are my concerns. One. The mandatory fun. We have a fun committee. It meets at six a.m. It is not fun. Two. The feedback system, in which you may give anonymous feedback, provided you sign it.
units.name: DONNA

units.text: Three. The word "synergy" was used forty-one times at Tuesday's all-hands, and I counted because I was told to be present.
units.name: DONNA

units.text: And four. I have given this place nine years. I have painted forty thousand nails. Nobody has ever once asked me what colour I would choose.
units.name: DONNA
paren: a long breath, shoulders dropping, eyes wet and furious

units.text: This one. It is called "Quarterly Growth." I picked it. I would like it on the record that I picked it.
units.name: DONNA
paren: reaches for a bottle at the edge of frame, a deep, ugly green; holds it up

units.text: Marcy. Marty. If you are watching this, and I know you are, because the call is on the big screen in the lobby--
units.name: DONNA
paren: screws the cap off, looks at the camera

units.text: Hi. We'll finish this in the all-hands.
units.name: DONNA
paren: freezes; slowly turns her head toward the door; turns back, composed

units.text: Thank you for your time. Please rate this statement out of five.
units.name: DONNA
paren: reaches for the laptop, hand shaking, cheerful

units.text: SUPER: "THIS CALL HAS BEEN RECORDED FOR TRAINING PURPOSES"
